question: Which of the following is a flightless bird?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kiwi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kiwi is a** flightless bird** found only in** New Zealand**.
 
• Kiwis are **pear-shaped endemic flightless birds with long legs and beaks.**
 
• Their closest relatives are the** emu, ostrich, cassowary, and rhea.**
 
• **Kiwis are found only in New Zealand** in** forests, scrublands, and grasslands.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Crane:**

 
 
• Cranes are **flying birds** and they can sustain speeds of **30 mph** by flying with flapping winds.
 
 
 
• **Peacock:** 
 
 
• Peacocks are also one of the **fastest running birds** which can run at a speed of** 10 mph**.
